verdict.rationale: Gitea documents a versioned REST API: every example targets the /api/v1 base, and the Swagger and OpenAPI documents use basePath /api/v1. The docs site also keeps per-release versions. However, the vendor's own API guide evidence explicitly notes that no deprecation or backward-compatibility statement exists in the guide, FAQ, or per-release docs, so only the versioning half of the story is delivered. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, backward-compatibility guarantees, independent corroboration of API version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
